title: Count sheets, not just rolls
hook: Six rolls or four rolls? The count inside each roll changes the arithmetic.

knows: that a model can declare hypothetical quantities
doesNotKnow: Calculate the usable unit count inside multipacks before comparing prices.

misconception: More rolls necessarily means more usable paper.
objective: Calculate the usable unit count inside multipacks before comparing prices.

claims.text: A costs €6: six rolls of 120 sheets. B costs €5: four rolls of 240 sheets. Scaled model; identical sheet size; fictional prices.
claims.source: Declared hypothetical inputs and limits in resource-specs.json. No actual product, price, tariff, shelf-life, treatment or physical appliance specification is asserted.

claims.text: The stage's two results are computed by the printed expressions. At Sheets/roll=240, A=0.008€/sheet and B=0.005€/sheet. Geometry follows the declared dimension relationships. Other pictures use a fixed full scale across the slider range; continuous fills and arcs show relative amounts rather than literal object counts.
claims.source: src/lib/lifehacks/resource-specs.json contains this lesson's numeric AST; src/lib/lifehacks/resource-model.ts evaluates it. A=["/",6,["*",6,120]]; B=["/",5,["*",4,"x"]]; x denotes Sheets/roll. At x=240, A=0.00833333333333, B=0.00520833333333; recall at x=270: B=0.00462962962963. Values are fictional/ideal assumptions, not measurements. Display rounds to at most three decimals. Diagram scale: resourceGraphicScale in resource-model.ts takes the maximum modeled magnitude across both formulas and the declared slider range. For non-geometry figures, full-scale values are displayed; the scale stays fixed when the slider changes. Energy axis endpoints use resourceAxisEnd, including B=5×A hours in lh-watts-hours-trade; cylinder rx and ry both scale with radius in resourceCylinderDimensions.

claims.text: The denominator is total sheets: rolls multiplied by sheets per roll. Comparing only roll counts hides the usable quantity. This model assumes equal sheet size and quality.

claims.text: A unit price expresses cost per stated quantity; comparable unit-price labels use consistent units of measure.
claims.source: https://nvlpubs.nist.gov/nistpubs/SpecialPublications/1181e2025/NIST.SP.1181e2025.html NIST SP 1181-2025, Definitions / Unit Pricing and E-Commerce. Opened 2026-10-13. Dataset prices and package amounts are invented for the arithmetic demonstration.

recall.question: A costs €6: six rolls of 120 sheets. B costs €5: four rolls of 240 sheets. Change only Sheets/roll to 270. What is B (Four-rolls) now?
recall.why: Use B's stated rule with Sheets/roll=270: it gives 0.005€/sheet. The denominator is total sheets: rolls multiplied by sheets per roll. Comparing only roll counts hides the usable quantity. This model assumes equal sheet size and quality.

safety.assumptions: A costs €6: six rolls of 120 sheets. B costs €5: four rolls of 240 sheets.
safety.excluded: No chemical mixtures, medical advice, wiring, safety-device bypass, actual tariffs, financial recommendations, temperature, food-storage or food-safety instructions. All energy powers, durations and tariffs are illustrative.
